33.77232,-118.35343: Storm Hill Park This land was gifted by Walter & Lisa Storm for the benefit of the residents of Rolling Hills. The storm family we're all avid riders, and it was their desire to preserve the natural beauty of undeveloped riding paths and canyons so future generations would be able to see the natural state of this beautiful area. The Storm family hopes you enjoy the view and peacefulness of this unique park, a place where cows used to graze and horse riders were always welcome.
